The main takeaway from our work is that
the water isotope response of GCMs to orbital forcing is strongly controlled by the simulated mean state of the climate, in particular the simulated mean precipitation and the associated water cycle.

the isotope enabled GCM MIROC iso is able to reproduce the water isotope variations in ice cores and in speleothems in a way consistent with the paleoclimate simulations of the fully coupled atmosphere-ocean GCM MIROC AOGC.
